abstract: Speech Language Models (SLMs) inherit strong instruction-following capabilities from pretrained language models, yet ASR specialization can substantially degrade them. To address this ASR--QA trade-off, we propose Task-Specific On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which leverages models before and after ASR specialization as complementary QA and ASR teachers. The student generates separate task-conditioned trajectories for ASR and QA, each supervised only by its corresponding teacher, thereby reducing direct competition between the two supervision signals. Experiments on basic ASR, contextual ASR, and QA demonstrate that TS-OPD improves recognition while preserving QA capability. Moreover, TS-OPD remains robust across different balancing coefficients and continues to benefit from increased distillation data.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对语音语言模型做自动语音识别特化后语音问答能力下降的问题，论文用特化前模型做问答老师、特化后模型做识别老师，让学生按任务分别采样轨迹并只接受对应老师的监督，在 500 小时蒸馏数据上提升识别的同时保住问答，但全文特化模型本身的识别上限仍未被完全追平。
originalTitle: TS-OPD: Reconciling ASR and QA in Speech Language Models via Task-Specific On-Policy Distillation
readerTitle: 特化前后来当老师：用任务专属在线蒸馏调和语音模型的转写与问答
